limitations.note: The rewrite still gives the wrong result on the affected transition paths when d2 is high on consecutive sampled cycles, because it suppresses the second deposit instead of taking S1 to S2 or, with sel high, S1_5 to S2_5.

limitations.quote: I’ll keep dispensing aligned to the rising edge and track the balance and change owed in half-yuan units.
limitations.note: The rewrite replaced the original combinational output decode with registered outputs, summed simultaneous coin inputs instead of prioritizing d1, and added multi-cycle change dispensing, none of which the two-transition fix required.
The test used the rewrite’s edge-filtering and payout rules as its oracle, so even exhaustive short sequences could not catch disagreements with the original FSM behavior.
